accountLoad.title: We couldn't load your account
accountLoad.body: You're still signed in. Check your connection and try again—there's no need to enter your password again.

authBootstrap.title: Signing you in…
authBootstrap.body: Your account is secure. We're preparing your Sober Helpline experience.

navPurpose.support: Support: talk to someone or find treatment

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong on our side.
errorBoundary.body: Your data is safe. If you need support right now, call 988 or 911.

familySquares.name: Family Squares
familySquares.rsvpNote: Your RSVP and questions go to Matt along with soberhelpline.com registrations. If it's your first call, you may get a follow-up email afterward.
familySquares.alreadyRegistered: You’re already registered. We look forward to seeing you Monday evening!

weekly.title: Save my seat every Monday
weekly.desc: We'll save your seat at Family Squares each week, so you don't have to do it again.
weekly.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

calendar.label: Add Family Squares to my calendar
calendar.errorBody: Please try again in a moment.

decline.label: Tell us you can't make it to Family Squares this week
decline.done: You're sitting this week out. If that changes, you can save your spot again.
decline.doneWeekly: You're sitting this week out. Your seat is saved again from next Monday. If this week changes, you can save your spot again.
decline.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

firstTime.title: What to expect your first time
firstTime.zoom: It's on Zoom. Tapping Join opens it for you.
firstTime.camera: Camera on or off is up to you, and a first name is all you need.
firstTime.listen: You're welcome to just listen. Nobody has to speak.
firstTime.length: It lasts about an hour, Matt Brown leads it, and it's free.
firstTime.dismissLabel: Hide what to expect at Family Squares

reminderAsk.seatBody: Want a reminder? We'll send one an hour before, and a tap-to-join 15 minutes before it starts.
reminderAsk.todayBody: Want a reminder before Monday's meeting? We'll let you know when it's coming up, with a tap to join.
reminderAsk.remindMeLabel: Remind me about the Monday meeting
reminderAsk.notNowLabel: Not now. Hide this reminder offer
reminderAsk.settingsBody: Reminders are off for Sober Helpline on this device. You can turn them on in Settings.
reminderAsk.openSettingsLabel: Open this device's Settings to allow notifications
reminderAsk.on: Reminders are on. We'll let you know before the meeting.
reminderAsk.failed: We couldn't turn reminders on just now. Check your connection and try again.

laSobremesa.note: La Sobremesa is AyudaSobria's Spanish-language meeting. Reserving gives you your personal link here and by email. By reserving you agree to respect the privacy and confidentiality of the other families.
laSobremesa.notAvailable: The next meeting isn't open for reservations yet. Please try again later.
